adst-artistic-application--culinary-arts.phrase: apply a range of artistic elements to the way dishes are plated and presented

next_steps.emerging: use one artistic element, such as colour, on purpose when plating a dish
next_steps.developing: practise choosing artistic elements that suit the dish being presented
next_steps.proficient: combine several artistic elements on one plate so they work together
next_steps.extending: explain how each artistic element on a plate supports the dish

strength: {He} [uses|use] colour and texture on purpose when {he} [plates|plate] a dish.
{He} can combine several artistic elements on one plate so the dish looks finished.

next.developing: {His} next step is to plan the look of a plate before {he} [starts|start] cooking.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try varying the height and shape of food to give a plate more interest.
next.extending: {He} [is|are] ready to explain how each artistic choice on a plate suits the dish.

adst-artistic-application--culinary-arts.home: When you eat together, ask {him} what {he} would change to make the plate look more inviting.

adst-artistic-elements--culinary-arts-11.phrase: explore artistic elements while creating a dish and apply the ones that suit it

next_steps.emerging: try one new artistic element while creating a dish
next_steps.developing: describe the artistic elements tried in a dish and what each one added
next_steps.proficient: practise testing several artistic elements and keeping the ones that suit the dish
next_steps.extending: experiment with an artistic element and judge its effect on the whole dish

strength: {He} [tries|try] different artistic elements as {he} [creates|create] a dish.
{He} can describe the artistic choices {he} made in a dish and what each one added.

next.developing: A good next step is to try one artistic element {he} [has|have] not used before in each dish.
next.proficient: One habit to build is noting which artistic elements suit which kinds of dishes.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can explore how one artistic element changes the whole eating experience.

adst-artistic-elements--culinary-arts-11.home: At home, ask {him} to describe how {he} would make a simple meal look special on the plate.

adst-audience-choice--adst-8-9|all.phrase: decide how to share a finished product and who to share it with

next_steps.emerging: try naming one person who would want to see a finished product
next_steps.developing: choose a way to share a product that suits the people seeing it
next_steps.proficient: practise sharing the design process as well as the finished product
next_steps.extending: explain why a way of sharing fits the people it is meant for

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] a way to share {his} product that suits the people who will see it.
{He} can explain the steps {he} took to make a product when {he} [shows|show] it to others.

next.developing: {His} next step is to decide who would want to see {his} product before {he} [finishes|finish] it.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try showing the steps behind a product, not just the end result.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can practise asking the people who see {his} product what they noticed.

adst-audience-choice--adst-8-9|all.home: At home, ask {him} who {he} would most like to show {his} latest project to, and why.

adst-audience-choice--grade-10-design-te.phrase: decide how and with whom to share a product and the process behind it

next_steps.emerging: choose one audience for a finished product
next_steps.developing: match the way a product is shared to the people who will see it
next_steps.proficient: share the process behind a product, including the changes made
next_steps.extending: plan how to share a product so each audience gets what it needs

strength: {He} [picks|pick] an audience for {his} product and [presents|present] it in a way that suits them.
When {he} [presents|present] a product, {he} [explains|explain] the process and the changes {he} made.

next.developing: A next step for {him} is to decide who should see {his} product while {he} [is|are] making it.
next.proficient: A good next step is to explain {his} process in words that suit the audience.
next.extending: {He} [is|are] ready to share {his} work with people outside the classroom who would use it.

adst-audience-choice--grade-10-design-te.home: At home, ask {him} which changes {he} made to a project and why {he} made them.

adst-audience-choice--culinary-arts|all.phrase: explore ways to share or promote culinary dishes, and who to share them with

next_steps.emerging: name one group of people who would enjoy a dish
next_steps.developing: explore more than one way to share or promote a dish
next_steps.proficient: choose how to promote a dish so it appeals to the people it is for
next_steps.extending: explain how sharing a dish can show the thinking and creativity behind it

strength: {He} [explores|explore] different ways to share a dish with the people who will eat it.
{He} can describe a dish in a way that makes people want to try it.

next.developing: {His} next step is to think about who a dish is for before deciding how to share it.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try describing the ideas behind a dish when {he} [promotes|promote] it.
next.extending: From here, {he} can practise promoting {his} culinary ideas to people beyond the kitchen.

adst-audience-choice--culinary-arts|all.home: Over a meal, ask {him} how {he} would describe the dish to someone who has never tried it.

adst-audience-choice--food-studies|all.phrase: decide how to share a prepared food product and who to share it with

next_steps.emerging: name who a prepared food product is meant for
next_steps.developing: choose a way of sharing food that suits the people receiving it
next_steps.proficient: practise explaining how a food product was made when sharing it
next_steps.extending: plan the sharing of a food product around the needs of its audience

strength: {He} [thinks|think] about who will eat a food product when {he} [decides|decide] how to share it.
{He} can explain the ingredients and steps behind a food product {he} [shares|share].

next.developing: A good next step is to ask the people who taste {his} food what they think of it.
next.proficient: {He} can now practise matching the way {he} [serves|serve] food to the people eating it.
next.extending: To keep growing, {he} can plan how to share a food product before {he} [starts|start] making it.

adst-audience-choice--food-studies|all.home: When you share food with others, ask {him} how {he} would serve it to make guests feel welcome.

adst-audience-choice--textiles-10-11|all.phrase: decide how to share textile items and who to share them with

next_steps.emerging: name who would want to see or use a textile item
next_steps.developing: choose a way to share a textile item that suits its audience
next_steps.proficient: explain the making of a textile item when sharing it
next_steps.extending: plan how to share textile items so each audience sees what matters to them

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] who to share a textile item with, based on who would wear or use it.
When {he} [shares|share] a textile item, {he} [describes|describe] the materials and methods {he} used.

next.developing: {His} next step is to decide how to show the steps of making a textile item.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try sharing a textile item in two different ways and comparing the response.
next.extending: {He} [is|are] ready to plan how a textile item will be shared before it is finished.

adst-audience-choice--textiles-10-11|all.home: At home, ask {him} who {he} would give a handmade item to, and how {he} would present it.

adst-audience-choice--textiles-12-fashio.phrase: decide how and with whom to share or promote fashion and textile work

next_steps.emerging: name an audience for a fashion or textile piece
next_steps.developing: choose ways to promote a piece that suit its audience
next_steps.proficient: explain how sharing work affects who owns the ideas in it
next_steps.extending: plan how to promote a body of work while protecting the ideas behind it

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] ways to promote a fashion or textile piece that suit the people it is for.
{He} [thinks|think] about how to share {his} designs while keeping credit for {his} ideas.

next.developing: A next step for {him} is to name the audience for a piece before planning how to promote it.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise explaining what makes {his} fashion or textile work {his} own.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can practise deciding which ideas to share openly and which to protect.

adst-audience-choice--textiles-12-fashio.home: At home, ask {him} how a clothing brand gets people to notice its designs.

adst-audience-choice--family-studies|all.phrase: decide how and with whom to share ideas, strategies and services

next_steps.emerging: name who would benefit from an idea or strategy
next_steps.developing: choose a way to share a strategy that suits the people it could help
next_steps.proficient: adjust how a strategy is shared for different families or groups
next_steps.extending: explain why a way of sharing a service or strategy fits its audience

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] who to share a strategy with by thinking about who it could help.
{He} [shares|share] ideas in a way that respects the families and groups {he} [is|are] speaking to.

next.developing: {His} next step is to think about what a family needs to hear before sharing an idea with them.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try sharing the same strategy in two ways for two different groups.
next.extending: {He} [is|are] ready to promote a service or strategy to the people in the community who need it.

adst-audience-choice--family-studies|all.home: At home, ask {him} who could use one of {his} ideas, and how {he} would share it.

adst-audience-choice--technology-11-feed.phrase: decide how and with whom to share a design and process to gather feedback

next_steps.emerging: choose one person to share a process with for feedback
next_steps.developing: share a process with people who can give useful feedback
next_steps.proficient: practise asking focused questions when sharing work for feedback
next_steps.extending: plan when to share work so feedback arrives in time to use

strength: {He} [shares|share] {his} process with people who know enough to give useful feedback.
{He} [asks|ask] questions about {his} work that help others give feedback {he} can use.

next.developing: A good next step is to share {his} process early, while there is time to change it.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise choosing people with different kinds of experience to review {his} work.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can keep a record of the feedback {he} [gets|get] and what {he} changed.

adst-audience-choice--technology-11-feed.home: At home, ask {him} which part of {his} current project {he} would like advice on.

adst-audience-choice--technology-11-12-p.phrase: decide how and with whom to share or promote a design and its process

next_steps.emerging: name an audience who would want to see a design
next_steps.developing: choose ways to share a design and its process that suit the audience
next_steps.proficient: promote a design by showing the problem it solves and how it was made
next_steps.extending: plan how to promote a design to the people most likely to use it

strength: {He} can promote a design by explaining the problem it solves.
{He} [shows|show] the thinking behind {his} design, not just the finished piece.

next.developing: {His} next step is to match each way of sharing a design to a specific audience.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise presenting {his} design process in a short, simple form.
next.extending: {He} can now try promoting a design to people who could use or make it.

adst-audience-choice--technology-11-12-p.home: At home, ask {him} who would buy or use the thing {he} [is|are] making, and why.

adst-audience-choice--computing-media-de.phrase: decide how to share or promote digital work and protect the ideas in it

next_steps.emerging: name an audience for a digital product
next_steps.developing: choose where and how to share digital work so its audience can find it
next_steps.proficient: decide how to credit and protect the ideas in shared work
next_steps.extending: plan how to promote digital work while managing who can use or copy it

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] places to share digital work where its audience will see it.
{He} [knows|know] when {his} work includes ideas {he} should credit or protect.

next.developing: A next step for {him} is to describe the audience for {his} digital work in a sentence.
next.proficient: One thing to practise is deciding what rights others have to reuse {his} work.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can plan how to promote {his} digital work over time, not just once.

adst-audience-choice--computing-media-de.home: At home, ask {him} where {he} would post {his} work online, and who would see it there.

adst-audience-choice--business-tourism|a.phrase: decide how and with whom to share or promote a product or service

next_steps.emerging: name the customers a product or service is meant for
next_steps.developing: choose a way to promote a product or service that reaches its customers
next_steps.proficient: compare ways of promoting a product or service and choose one with reasons
next_steps.extending: plan promotion that also protects the ideas behind a product or service

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] ways to promote a product or service that reach the right customers.
{He} [thinks|think] about how to protect a business idea while promoting it.

next.developing: {He} [is|are] ready to describe the customer a product or service is for before promoting it.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try comparing two ways to promote the same service and judging which reaches more people.
next.extending: From here, {he} can practise deciding which business ideas to share and which to keep private.

adst-audience-choice--business-tourism|a.home: Next time you see an ad, ask {him} who it is meant for and how {he} can tell.

adst-best-practices--culinary-arts-10|al.phrase: follow the best practices of a culinary professional while working in the kitchen

next_steps.emerging: describe the practices a culinary professional follows
next_steps.developing: follow professional practices for each kitchen task
next_steps.proficient: follow professional practices for a whole shift, from setup to cleanup
next_steps.extending: model professional practices so others in the kitchen can follow them

strength: {He} [keeps|keep] a clean, organized station, as a culinary professional would.
{He} [shows|show] professional habits in the kitchen, such as arriving ready and following directions.

next.developing: One thing to practise is following each professional practice without needing a reminder.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can make a habit of cleaning as {he} [works|work].
next.extending: To go further, {he} can practise showing newer cooks the professional habits {he} [follows|follow].

adst-best-practices--culinary-arts-10|al.home: When you cook together, ask {him} which kitchen habits a professional chef would expect.

adst-boundary-decisions--business-comput.phrase: decide the starting assumptions and limits that define a business computing task

next_steps.emerging: state what a task includes and what it leaves out
next_steps.developing: decide which assumptions a task starts from
next_steps.proficient: explain how the chosen limits shape the way a task is done
next_steps.extending: test a task's assumptions and adjust the limits when they no longer fit

strength: {He} [decides|decide] what a task includes and what it leaves out before {he} [begins|begin].
{He} can name the assumptions a task depends on, such as who will use the result.

next.developing: {His} next step is to state the limits of a task in a sentence before starting.
next.proficient: {He} can now practise explaining how a different assumption would change the task.
next.extending: A good next step is to revisit {his} assumptions partway through a task.

adst-boundary-decisions--business-comput.home: At home, ask {him} what a big job, like planning a trip, would include and leave out.

adst-boundary-decisions--economics-12|al.phrase: decide the assumptions and limits that define an economic scenario

next_steps.emerging: state what an economic scenario includes and leaves out
next_steps.developing: choose the assumptions an economic scenario starts from
next_steps.proficient: explain how changing one assumption changes an economic scenario
next_steps.extending: defend the limits set for an economic scenario against other choices

strength: {He} [sets|set] clear limits on what an economic scenario includes.
{He} [names|name] the assumptions an economic scenario rests on before {he} [uses|use] it.

next.developing: A next step for {him} is to list the assumptions in a scenario before drawing conclusions.
next.proficient: {He} [is|are] ready to test how a scenario changes when one assumption is removed.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can practise explaining why {his} chosen limits suit the question being asked.

adst-boundary-decisions--economics-12|al.home: At home, ask {him} what a family would assume when planning a monthly budget.

adst-business-software--business-compute.phrase: use business software to organize data and find solutions to business problems

next_steps.emerging: enter and organize data in business software
next_steps.developing: use software tools to sort and analyze data for a business problem
next_steps.proficient: explain how the organized data supports a chosen solution
next_steps.extending: choose the software tool that fits each type of business problem

strength: {He} [organizes|organize] business data in software so it can be sorted and compared.
{He} [uses|use] the data {he} [organizes|organize] to support a solution to a business problem.

next.developing: A useful habit is to name the business question before {he} [opens|open] the software.
next.proficient: One habit to build is checking {his} data for errors before using it to decide.
next.extending: {He} can now try showing the same data in two ways to see which explains the solution more plainly.

adst-business-software--business-compute.home: At home, ask {him} how {he} would organize the costs of a family event to make a decision.

adst-challenge-choice--family-and-societ.phrase: choose a service design challenge that affects families and explain why it matters

next_steps.emerging: describe a challenge that families face
next_steps.developing: choose a challenge that a service could help families with
next_steps.proficient: explain how the chosen challenge affects different families
next_steps.extending: narrow a family challenge to one a service could realistically address

strength: {He} [chooses|choose] a challenge that real families face and a service could help with.
{He} can explain how a challenge affects the daily life of a family.

next.developing: A useful habit is to ask whether a challenge affects many families or a few.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try describing a challenge from the point of view of a family member.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can practise narrowing a broad challenge to one a service could meet.

adst-challenge-choice--family-and-societ.home: At home, ask {him} what would make daily life easier for a busy household.

adst-challenge-response--culinary-arts-f.phrase: anticipate challenges in the kitchen and solve them as they arise

next_steps.emerging: spot one challenge before starting a kitchen task
next_steps.developing: plan a way to handle a challenge before it happens
next_steps.proficient: practise solving challenges calmly while a dish is being made
next_steps.extending: explain how a plan prevented a problem and what to try next time

strength: {He} [spots|spot] likely problems, such as timing or missing ingredients, before {he} [starts|start] cooking.
When something goes wrong in the kitchen, {he} [finds|find] a way to fix it.

next.developing: A good next step is to list possible problems with a recipe before {he} [begins|begin].
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise staying calm and changing plans when a kitchen task goes wrong.
next.extending: {He} [is|are] ready to reflect on how {he} handled a challenge and what {he} would do next time.

adst-challenge-response--culinary-arts-f.home: When you cook together, ask {him} what could go wrong with the meal and how to prevent it.

adst-clear-communication--economics-12|a.phrase: communicate economic findings clearly and concisely in more than one format

next_steps.emerging: share results in one clear format
next_steps.developing: state each point of a result in plain language
next_steps.proficient: present the same findings both as a chart and in writing
next_steps.extending: cut extra detail so each format carries the main message

strength: {He} [shares|share] economic findings in more than one format, such as a chart and a short summary.
{He} [keeps|keep] {his} message short by leaving out details that are not needed.

next.developing: One habit to build is stating the main finding in one sentence before adding detail.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can try choosing the format that suits each audience best.
next.extending: To keep growing, {he} can practise cutting a report to half its length without losing the main point.

adst-clear-communication--economics-12|a.home: At home, ask {him} to explain one thing {he} learned in Economics in two sentences.

adst-clientele-service--culinary-arts|al.phrase: identify the clientele and type of service, and follow service steps that suit them

next_steps.emerging: identify the customers to be served
next_steps.developing: identify the type of food service to provide
next_steps.proficient: follow service steps that suit the customers and the type of service
next_steps.extending: adjust service steps when the customers or the type of service changes

strength: {He} can identify who the customers are and what type of service suits them.
{He} [follows|follow] service steps that fit the type of service being offered.

next.developing: One thing to practise is asking what customers need before service begins.
next.proficient: A next step for {him} is to explain why each service step suits the clientele.
next.extending: From here, {he} can practise adjusting service steps for a different type of service.

adst-clientele-service--culinary-arts|al.home: When you eat together, ask {him} what a host can do to make guests feel welcome.

adst-community-needs--media-design-10|al.phrase: recognize community needs and explain how meeting them helps the community over time

next_steps.emerging: describe one need in the community
next_steps.developing: explain how meeting a community need helps the community in the years ahead
next_steps.proficient: connect several community needs and explain how they affect each other
next_steps.extending: explain how a media design could meet a community need without creating new problems

strength: {He} can describe a need in {his} community and who it affects.
{He} [explains|explain] how meeting a need now could help the community in the future.

next.developing: {His} next step is to ask people in the community what they need.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise linking two community needs and how one affects the other.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can try explaining how a media design could meet one need without harming another.

adst-community-needs--media-design-10|al.home: At home, ask {him} what your neighbourhood needs most, and who would benefit.

adst-competing-factors--community-needs|.phrase: decide which concerns matter most when a design is meant to help the community

next_steps.emerging: name the concerns a design raises for the community
next_steps.developing: give a reason for which concern matters most in a design
next_steps.proficient: practise weighing two concerns against each other before making a design choice
next_steps.extending: explain how a design choice helps the community in the future

strength: {He} can say how a design might help or harm people in {his} community.
When two concerns do not fit together, {he} [chooses|choose] one and [explains|explain] why it matters more.

next.developing: A good next step is to ask who a design leaves out each time {he} [plans|plan] one.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise asking how a design would change if another concern came first.
next.extending: {He} [is|are] ready to think about how a design will affect the community years from now.

adst-competing-factors--community-needs|.home: At home, ask {him} what {he} would change about your neighbourhood, and who the change would help.

adst-competing-factors--community-needs|.phrase: prioritize competing concerns when a design meets a community need

next_steps.emerging: name the concerns that conflict in a community design
next_steps.developing: explain the order of priorities behind each design choice
next_steps.proficient: weigh the trade-offs between priorities with evidence
next_steps.extending: make a habit of testing a set of priorities against the community's needs and hopes

strength: {He} can explain which group in the community each concern speaks for.
{He} [ranks|rank] the concerns in a design and [gives|give] a reason for the order {he} [chooses|choose].

next.developing: {His} next step is to state the cost of each priority in plain terms.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can make a habit of writing {his} priorities down before {he} [commits|commit] to a design.
next.extending: From here, {he} can practise judging how {his} priorities shape the future the community wants.

adst-competing-factors--community-needs|.home: At home, ask {him} which should count more when buying something, its price or its effect on the planet.

adst-competing-factors--family-needs|10-.phrase: explain how the needs of a person, a family and a community can compete

next_steps.emerging: name each person's needs in a family situation
next_steps.developing: practise explaining how meeting one need affects the others
next_steps.proficient: weigh individual, family and community needs before choosing a response
next_steps.extending: judge which response serves a family's future, and explain why

strength: {He} can explain how a choice that suits one family member can strain the rest of the family.
{He} [connects|connect] a family's choices to the needs of the wider community.

next.developing: A next step for {him} is to practise asking who gains and who loses in a family decision.
next.proficient: One thing to practise is giving reasons for which need should guide a decision.
next.extending: To go further, {he} can think ahead to how a choice made today shapes a family's future.

adst-competing-factors--family-needs|10-.home: At home, ask {him} how your family decides when two people need different things.

adst-competing-factors--food-10|10-12.phrase: explain how competing concerns shape food choices and the way food is prepared

next_steps.emerging: name the concerns behind a food choice
next_steps.developing: explain how cost changes what a person chooses to make
next_steps.proficient: practise weighing two competing concerns before deciding how to prepare food
next_steps.extending: explain the trade-offs in a food choice and defend the balance chosen

{He} [links|link] the way food is prepared to its effect on the environment.

next.developing: {His} next step is to ask whether a food choice is fair to the people who grow the food.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can practise deciding which concern comes first when two of them conflict in the kitchen.
next.extending: {He} can now try explaining what is lost when food is made cheaper or with less waste.

adst-competing-factors--food-10|10-12.home: When you shop or cook together, ask {him} why {he} would choose one food over another.

adst-competing-factors--food-11-12|10-12.phrase: evaluate how competing concerns affect choices of food products, techniques and equipment

next_steps.emerging: name the social, ethical, cost and sustainability concerns in a food choice
next_steps.developing: explain how each concern changes a choice of product or technique
next_steps.proficient: set criteria and use them to judge food choices
next_steps.extending: defend a choice of product, technique and equipment against other options

strength: {He} can explain the social and ethical concerns behind a choice of food product.
{He} [weighs|weigh] cost against sustainability when {he} [chooses|choose] a technique or piece of equipment.

next.developing: A next step for {him} is to explain how a choice of equipment changes the cost of a meal.
next.proficient: Next, {he} can make a habit of noting the reason for each product {he} [chooses|choose].
next.extending: To keep growing, {he} can practise judging when a cheaper technique is worth its trade-off.

adst-competing-factors--food-11-12|10-12.home: At home, ask {him} what {he} [thinks|think] about when choosing between two brands of the same food.

adst-competing-factors--textiles-10-11|1.phrase: explain how competing concerns affect which textile items are available

next_steps.emerging: name a concern that affects whether a textile item is available
next_steps.developing: explain how cost shapes which textile items people can buy
next_steps.proficient: practise evaluating how ethical and sustainability concerns compete with cost
next_steps.extending: judge whether a lower price is worth its social and environmental costs

{He} [connects|connect] ethical concerns about how a textile item is made to whether people can buy it.

next.developing: {His} next step is to practise explaining how a sustainability concern limits the textile items for sale.
